note: An empty waivers array is a meaningful assertion here, and it is meaningful for the same reason it is in the R4D-2A corpus one directory over: there is no cross-engine comparison to waive anything from. This corpus records an operator CONTRACT. Every surface is produced by the grapt-service model from the action rows and compared exhaustively, with no normalisation, no tolerance and no excluded field. No engine is started, contacted or measured, nothing is compared against the frozen TypeScript engine, and no intentional non-parity can therefore arise. The day a live differential runs under this contract, any cross-engine difference must either fail a comparison or be named here; there is no global normalisation switch.
